packets.summary: Engineering documentation for a stave-built djembe — the West African goblet drum. Includes Helmholtz / Webster horn FEM analysis, segmented-construction study, and parametric goblet geometry CSV. Built at Morgan Drums (St. Paul, MN) 2010.
